name: Sudoku
description: Sudoku made on the frame: every puzzle is new and has exactly one solution, at the difficulty you pick (easy, medium, hard or expert). Tap a cell, then a number on the pad. Notes pencils small candidates in, Erase clears a cell, Undo takes the last change back, Hint fills a cell, Check marks the wrong ones, and digits that clash in a row, column or box are marked as you go (you can turn that off). The minutes played show beside the difficulty. The game in progress is kept, and a keyboard works too (arrows, digits, Backspace). High contrast on black-and-white panels.
